```abap
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
***INCLUDE LSCTMF01 .
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  local_start
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM LOCAL_START.
  DATA: LT_E071_TAB      LIKE E071 OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,
        LT_E071K_TAB     LIKE E071K OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA: I                TYPE I.
  DATA: LV_TRSTATUS      TYPE TRSTATUS.
  DATA: LT_E071_TRIGG    TYPE TABLE OF SCDT_E071_TRIGG WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA: LT_E071K_TRIGG   TYPE TABLE OF SCDT_E071K_TRIGG WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA: LT_GUID          TYPE TABLE OF SYSUUID_22 WITH HEADER LINE.

  CHECK GV_SUPPRESS_ON_COMMIT IS INITIAL.

  SORT IT_START_TAB DESCENDING.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM IT_START_TAB COMPARING TRKORR.
  LOOP AT IT_START_TAB.
    CLEAR LV_TRSTATUS.
    SELECT SINGLE TRSTATUS FROM E070 INTO LV_TRSTATUS
                           WHERE TRKORR = IT_START_TAB-TRKORR.
    LOOP AT IT_E071_TAB INTO LT_E071_TAB
            WHERE TRKORR = IT_START_TAB-TRKORR.
      APPEND LT_E071_TAB.
      DELETE IT_E071_TAB.
    ENDLOOP.
    LOOP AT IT_E071K_TAB INTO LT_E071K_TAB
            WHERE TRKORR = IT_START_TAB-TRKORR.
      APPEND LT_E071K_TAB.
      DELETE IT_E071K_TAB.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF LV_TRSTATUS <> 'D'.
*request was released -> collect all entries for TRKORR
      SELECT DISTINCT GUID FROM SCDT_E071_TRIGG INTO TABLE LT_GUID
                          WHERE TRKORR = IT_START_TAB-TRKORR.
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
        LOOP AT LT_GUID.
          SELECT * FROM SCDT_E071K_TRIGG INTO TABLE LT_E071K_TRIGG
                   WHERE GUID = LT_GUID.
          LOOP AT LT_E071K_TRIGG.
            MOVE-CORRESPONDING LT_E071K_TRIGG TO LT_E071K_TAB.
            LT_E071K_TAB-TRKORR = IT_START_TAB-TRKORR.
            APPEND LT_E071K_TAB.
          ENDLOOP.
          DELETE SCDT_E071K_TRIGG FROM TABLE LT_E071K_TRIGG.
        ENDLOOP.
        FREE LT_E071K_TRIGG.
        FREE LT_GUID.

        SELECT * FROM SCDT_E071_TRIGG INTO TABLE LT_E071_TRIGG
                            WHERE TRKORR = IT_START_TAB-TRKORR.

        LOOP AT LT_E071_TRIGG.
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING LT_E071_TRIGG TO LT_E071_TAB.
          APPEND LT_E071_TAB.
        ENDLOOP.
        DELETE SCDT_E071_TRIGG FROM TABLE LT_E071_TRIGG.
        FREE LT_E071_TRIGG.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DB_COMMIT'.
        WAIT UP TO 2 SECONDS.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    CALL FUNCTION 'SCDC_DISTRIBUTE_TABLE_KEYS'
               EXPORTING
                 PROJECT_ID        = IT_START_TAB-PROJECT_ID
                 TRKORR            = IT_START_TAB-TRKORR
               TABLES
                 E071_TAB          = LT_E071_TAB
                 E071K_TAB         = LT_E071K_TAB
               EXCEPTIONS
                 NO_PROJECT        = 0
                 OTHERS            = 0.
    IF LV_TRSTATUS = 'D' AND GV_GUID_22 <> SPACE.
    LOOP AT LT_E071K_TAB.
      I = STRLEN( LT_E071K_TAB-TABKEY ).
      IF I > 0.
        I = I - 1.
        IF LT_E071K_TAB-TABKEY+I(1) = '*'.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      DELETE FROM SCDT_E071K_TRIGG
          WHERE GUID    = GV_GUID_22
            AND OBJECT  = LT_E071K_TAB-OBJECT
            AND OBJNAME = LT_E071K_TAB-OBJNAME
            AND TABKEY  = LT_E071K_TAB-TABKEY.
        IF LT_E071K_TAB-OBJECT = 'TABU'.
          SELECT SINGLE * FROM SCDT_E071K_TRIGG INTO LT_E071K_TRIGG
              WHERE GUID    = GV_GUID_22
                AND OBJECT  = LT_E071K_TAB-OBJECT
                AND OBJNAME = LT_E071K_TAB-OBJNAME.
          IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
            DELETE FROM SCDT_E071_TRIGG
                WHERE GUID     = GV_GUID_22
                  AND OBJECT   = LT_E071K_TAB-OBJECT
                  AND OBJ_NAME = LT_E071K_TAB-OBJNAME.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DB_COMMIT'.
    ENDIF.
    REFRESH: LT_E071_TAB,
             LT_E071K_TAB.
    DELETE IT_START_TAB.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    " local_start

```
